$comment: Component manifest — every deliverable this project ships. EXAMPLE for a fictional habit tracker ('Habitude') that ships an iOS app, its API and a marketing site. /onboard generates the real components.json at the repo root from the Project shape questions (Q-S1/Q-S2). Read by /build-next (what to run), /verify (how to prove) and /status (what to report). A single-component project has exactly one entry — the structure never changes.
